title: Warranty Coverage Weekend Labor Schedule
content:
Labor billed on a Warranty Coverage technician visit takes a labor day rate by the day the labor was done:

| Day the labor was done | Labor day rate |
|---|---|
| Sunday | 1.5 (Sunday labor rate) |
| Saturday | 1.25 (Saturday labor rate) |
| Monday to Friday | none |

In clause form: labor done on a Sunday takes the Sunday labor rate, labor done on a Saturday takes the Saturday labor rate, and labor done on a weekday takes no labor day rate.

## Reading the day

The day is that of the visit date recorded on the visit, which is also the date the labor charge carries. Days of the week follow the ordinary calendar; for reference, 4 January 2026 was a Sunday.

## Cases (hypothetical)

| Visit dated | Day | Labor day rate |
|---|---|---|
| 10 January 2026 | Saturday | 1.25 |
| 11 January 2026 | Sunday | 1.5 |
| 12 January 2026 | Monday | none |
